name: truescrape
stderr:
Usage: truescrape [options] [command]

Public social media data from every platform in the catalogue. One key, one
schema.

Options:
  -v, --version                        output the version number
  --api-key <key>                      API key for this request only. Visible in
                                       shell history; prefer `auth login` or
                                       TRUESCRAPE_API_KEY
  --base-url <url>                     API base URL. Default:
                                       TRUESCRAPE_BASE_URL, else
                                       https://api.truescrape.com
  --format <format>                    Output format (choices: "json", "table",
                                       "csv", "markdown", default: "json")
  --pretty                             Indent JSON output
  --envelope                           Print { data, meta, pagination } instead
                                       of data alone
  --output <path>                      Write the output to a file and print only
                                       its path
  --quiet                              Suppress the billing line on stderr
  --no-color                           Disable colours
  --verbose                            Show request URL, status and timing on
                                       stderr
  -h, --help                           display help for command

Commands:
  auth                                 Store, check or remove the API key
  balance                              Show the credit balance for the current
                                       key
  config                               Read or write the config file. Keys:
                                       apiKey, baseUrl
  batch [options] <platform> <action>  Run one endpoint over many targets as an
                                       async job
  jobs                                 Async jobs started by `truescrape batch`:
                                       show one, wait on it, or list them
  download [options] <post-url>        Save the video from a public Instagram,
                                       Facebook or X post (1 credit for the
                                       lookup)
  mentions                             Find who is mentioning a name right now,
                                       across public sources
  monitors                             Keep watching a name or accounts: create,
                                       check, read what is new, delete
  mcp [options]                        Serve MCP over stdio for clients that
                                       launch a local process, bridging every
                                       message to the API
  agent                                Connect an agent client to the TrueScrape
                                       MCP server
  list [options] [platform]            Platforms in the catalogue, or every
                                       endpoint of one platform
  amazon                               amazon endpoints
  apple-music                          apple-music endpoints
  bitchute                             bitchute endpoints
  bluesky                              bluesky endpoints
  dailymotion                          dailymotion endpoints
  deezer                               deezer endpoints
  ebay                                 ebay endpoints
  facebook                             facebook endpoints
  github                               github endpoints
  google                               google endpoints
  hackernews                           hackernews endpoints
  identity                             identity endpoints
  inference                            inference endpoints
  instagram                            instagram endpoints
  kick                                 kick endpoints
  komi                                 komi endpoints
  kwai                                 kwai endpoints
  linkbio                              linkbio endpoints
  linkedin                             linkedin endpoints
  linkme
